description: This Java class, DriverFactory, manages WebDriver instances for different browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge). It creates drivers based on configuration, maintains thread safety via ThreadLocal storage, and provides methods to retrieve, create, and quit drivers.

classes.name: DriverFactory
classes.description: Class responsible for creating, managing, and quitting WebDriver instances for browser automation.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Returns the thread-local WebDriver instance, throws exception if not initialized.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Initializes a WebDriver for the specified browser and configuration, sets timeouts and window size.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver if it exists and removes it from thread-local storage.
